notes.title: Shivers, swag, shenanigans
notes.content:
[h1]Your quick peek at some the Halloween events in upjers games[/h1]

The night of Halloween is looming ahead. This means it‘s party-time for upjers!

We want to give you an overview on the [b]Halloween-Events[/b] starting across many games next 
week. Here‘s what you can expect:​

[h1]My Little Farmies[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/789100/My_Little_Farmies/

From [b]October 22nd to 29th[/b] the Halloween-themed collector-event is waiting for you. Decorate your village with eeriely-cute Voodoo decorations to collect all the [b]Shrunken head[/b]-tokens to win valuable prizes like the new [b]„Saddler‘s“[/b] production facility. There you can craft saddles and other products.

[h1]My Free Zoo[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/694130/My_Free_Zoo/

Is this too morbid for you? Then you may already be looking forward to collect [b]Lionhead tokens[/b] at My Free Zoo. Put up scary-looking glow-in-the-dark animal statues to have the chance to win the adorable and very exclusive [b]Siberian musk deer[/b] to exhibit in your zoo. ([i]The events runs 
between October 23rd and 30th.[/i])

[h1]My Free Farm[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1049880/My_Free_Farm/

This year the My Free Farm Halloween-Event is challenging your gray matter again! The [b]Halloween card-matching game[/b] is back! When you mange to clear all cards from the table within ten tries, you have the chance to win new amusing trophies for your collection. ([i]October 22nd 
through to November 5th[/i].)

But also your  [b]Horse Farm[/b] (24 – 30 October), [b]Wauies[/b] (24 – 31 October), [b]My Sunny Resort[/b] (23 – 30 October) and [b]My Free Farm 2[/b] (29 October – 5 November) are packed full with fun events 
to take the edge off the dark season.

notes.title: Little Imps available now!
notes.content:
The quiet days are over! The sound of numerous imps working to expand the underground lair puts a smile on the face of even the most miserable rules of the deep. With its humorous fantasy elements, its online coop mode and unique battle features, dungeon tycoon game „Little Imps: A Dungeon Builder“ is the right game for any aspiring prince of darkness.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33026505/9b43b55f5a92a4f01249e20ff71909953a39fbaf.jpg[/img]

The Steam early access version of „Little Imps: A Dungeon Builder“ is now available.

notes.title: Booster Week
notes.content:
[b]Dear Pet Shop Owners[/b],

It's time for another Booster week! Log in daily to get better boosters!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31510958/af1ce51e3d1263b84d2a2fb355ef0e3077c79158.jpg[/img]

All players that log in between [b]June 22[/b] at 12:01 am and [b]June 28[/b], 2018, at 11:59 pm CEST time, will receive a [b]SILVER BOOSTER[/b] instead of the regular bronze booster [b][u]every day[/u][/b]. 

Players that log in 3 days in a row, will even receive [b]a GOLD BOOSTER[/b] from the [b]4th day on[/b] (however, if you miss a day, you'll start getting silver boosters again)!

This is a great opportunity to score some fantastic items, or even one of our [b]three exclusive booster animals[/b], which can[b] only [/b]be found in Gold Boosters: The [b]Sachsengold Rabbit, Sphynx Cat and Discus Fish[/b]! Each [b]Gold Booster[/b] is [b]guaranteed[/b] to contain at least one!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31510958/f0ffe5d2bd2089b8a9fd00fcde5673bdce06f31d.jpg[/img]

[b][i]Enjoy the game![/i][/b]

Your [b]Wauies[/b] Team

notes.title: Mother's Day Event!
notes.content:
All most mothers want for Mother's Day is a little break from every day life. Time to sit back, be pampered and not have to worry about everything. The youngsters in the pet store are doing their best to oblige in this year's  [b]Mother's Day Event[/b] in Wauies!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31510958/8f2bec9addb92112e9fa66d3d9450fa2ecf2f270.jpg[/img]

For the duration of the event, you'll find the [b]seasonal section of your shop[/b] stocked with lovely Mother's Day decorations. Enchant your visitors with flowers, loving families, sweet gifts, and relaxing mothers.

Each Mother's Day decoration you place in your store will give you points in the form of [b]Heart Cupcakes[/b].

Collecting enough Heart Cupcakes before the event ends on [b]May 17 at 10:59 am CEST[/b] will allow you to earn some exciting rewards, including a brand-new animal - the [b]Castor Rex[/b]!

[b]5,000 Heart Cupcakes[/b] - Siberian Cat
[b]9,500 Heart Cupcakes[/b] - Gold Booster
[b]22,000 Heart Cupcakes[/b] - Castor Rex
[b]40,000 Heart Cupcakes[/b] - Siberian Cat
[b]65,000 Heart Cupcakes[/b] - Castor Rex

Calm and friendly, the Castor Rex rabbits are known to be very mothering - even towards other bunnies. They are very gentle and love hopping around with friends.

[i][b]Please note:[/b] [b]Only decorations placed in your store when the event ends on May 17, 2018 at 10:59 am CEST will count towards your reward. Items in your inventory will not count! So make sure to place everything you buy IN YOUR STORE.[/b]

notes.title: Cashback Sale!
notes.content:
Winter is on its way out and it's time to prepare the shop for the influx of spring customers and spruce things up a bit.

If you're rarin' to expand now, we have good news for you:                              

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31510958/9171ae379c1d994d6df2c3436585f1118a33d3e8.jpg[/img]

From [b]Thursday, February 15[/b], at [b]11:00 am[/b] until [b]Sunday, February 18[/b], at [b]11:59 pm[/b] CET, you'll have the chance to earn back [b]a percentage[/b] of the Diamonds you spend in the game. This is a great chance to save on fancy decorations, pens, equipment, staff and more! The more you spend, the more you save - you can get [b]up to 25% of the Diamonds[/b] you spend back!

[i]But it gets even better![/i]  At the 100 and 2000 thresholds, you'll also get a [b][color=#715E56]Bull Terrier[/b] on top of your Diamond reimbursement! 

The more Diamonds you spend, the more you'll get!

[list][i][b]0-100 Diamonds:[/b][/i] [b]5%[/b] of your Diamonds back
[i][b]100-500 Diamonds:[/b] [/i][b]10%[/b] of your Diamonds back + [b]1 Bull Terrier[/b]
[i][b]500-1000 Diamonds:[/b] [/i][b]15%[/b] of your Diamonds back 
[i][b]1000-2000 Diamonds:[/b][/i] [b]20%[/b] of your Diamonds back 
[i][b]2000+ Diamonds:[/b][/i] [b]25%[/b] of your Diamonds back +[b]1 Bull Terrier[/b][/list]

[i]The [b]card prizes are cumulative [/b]- that means if you spend 2000 Diamonds, you will get 500 Diamonds (25%) back and get a total of 2 Bull Terriers![/i]

Bull Terriers are stubborn clowns. They can be a bit obstinate but are loving family dogs. They will feel most comfortable in [i]upholstered, aspen bedding and straw enclosures[/i].

The Diamonds will be paid out upon logging in between [b]Monday, February 19, at 11:00 am[/b] and Monday, February 26, at 10:59 am CET.

In the game, you'll see a [b]symbol on the right side of the screen[/b] that will show when the event starts, and later, what you'll get back. During the weekend event, all premium expenditures will be logged there, and you'll be shown what you'll get on Monday.
